title: Extending SycophantSee: Activation Diagnostics for a Second Misalignment Behavior

original_idea.body:
# Extending SycophantSee: Activation Diagnostics for a Second Misalignment Behavior

**Problem:** The SycophantSee hackathon result showed activation-based diagnostics can monitor sycophancy at prompt- and generation-time. Whether the same simple linear-probe recipe transfers to a different misalignment behavior (e.g. deference-to-authority or refusal-faking) is open.

**Direction:** Reuse the SycophantSee probing recipe (collect activations on contrastive paired prompts, fit a logistic probe) but target one new behavior on a small open model. Build a tiny contrastive dataset, train the probe on a few layers, and report whether the probe separates the behavior at generation time, with a held-out test split.

**Why it matters:** Demonstrating that the cheap activation-diagnostic recipe generalizes (or not) to a new behavior tells the field how much per-behavior engineering monitoring requires. Probing an existing open model needs no training and fits 30h.

**Relevant context:** Context file Recent Surprising Results: 'SycophantSee: activation-based diagnostics can monitor sycophancy at prompt and generation time — Apart Research hackathon', with explicit follow-up suggestion to 'extend to other misalignment behaviors'.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: activation diagnostics aid misalignment monitoring, but transfer-to-one-behavior result is a modest step in a longer monitoring program.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: probe-only on small open model, contrastive dataset, logistic regression; motivated beginner can progress.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single experiment: train probe, test held-out split, report separability.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, no internal access, monitoring research labs under-prioritize per-behavior generalization.

low_compute.reasoning: Probing pre-trained model, no training, single GPU/analytical.

novelty.reasoning: Probing recipe is published; this specific behavior-transfer angle may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Activation probing is well-studied; transfer to a new behavior may be open.
